description: PERRY CONTINUES FIGHT AGAINST SYNTHETIC DRUGS LUBBOCK, TX – Today, Senator Charles Perry filed SB 461 to give law enforcement the ability to tackle the issue of synthetic drugs from the angle of mislabeling. Senators Kevin Eltife (R – Tyler), Juan “Chuy” Hinojosa (D – McAllen) and Jose Rodriguez
title: Press Release: Perry Continues the Fight Against Synthetic Drugs — Elect Charles Perry
